description: This source file contains internal classes for testing and providing system hooks within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes implementations for environment statistics provider and system target for test hooks, enabling functionality such as retrieving silo information, checking storage and stream providers, and unregistering grains for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestHooksEnvironmentStatisticsProvider
classes.description: A fake environment statistics provider used for testing purposes, implementing IEnvironmentStatisticsProvider.

classes.name: TestHooksSystemTarget
classes.description: A system target class for test hooks, enabling retrieval of silo status, provider info, and grain unregistration, used for internal testing.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Returns current environment statistics, fetching real statistics if current are invalid or null.

methods.name: LatchHardwareStatistics
methods.description: Sets the current environment statistics to the provided stats.

methods.name: UnlatchHardwareStatistics
methods.description: Resets the current environment statistics to null.

methods.name: TestHooksSystemTarget
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test hooks system target with required services.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: No-op method for initializing the system target.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Returns the primary target silo address for a given key in the consistent ring.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingProviderDiagnosticInfo
methods.description: Returns diagnostic info about the consistent ring provider.

methods.name: GetServiceId
methods.description: Retrieves the service ID from the service provider options.

methods.name: HasStorageProvider
methods.description: Checks if a storage provider with a given name exists.

methods.name: HasStreamProvider
methods.description: Checks if a stream provider with a given name exists.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainForTesting
methods.description: Unregisters a grain for testing purposes and returns the result.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves approximate statuses of silos from the silo status oracle.
